newsitem.title: USA: Movie Gallery sees Q2 shr loss.
newsitem.headline: Movie Gallery sees Q2 shr loss.

text.p: Movie Gallery Inc said Monday it expects to report a loss for the second quarter of of $0.06 to $0.09 per share.
Wall Street had been expecting a second quarter profit of $0.17 a share, according to First Call estimates.
The company reported a loss of $0.16 per share for the 1996 second quarter.

It said same-store revenues for the second quarter will be down about two percent from the second quarter 1996. The company attributed its statement to lower-than-expected rental revenues and increased amortization of videocassette rental inventory.

It said the revenue shortfall is largely the result of significant competion in urban locations, a decision to start aggressive promotions to preserve and build market share and continued industry softness that began in the first quarter.

Additionally, it said it increased its rental inventory in the first and second quarters and as a result, experienced increased amortization of videocassette rental inventory, which it said lowered profit margins.
